'''March 2000 Terre Haute tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Terre Haute, Indiana on 18 March 2000. [[Erik Winings]] won it. It is known from Matthew Wright's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d358">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-19-terre-haute-indiana-3-18-00d358/ terre-haute-indiana-3-18-00], DeckTech (Matthew "Teknologik" Wright, 19 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-19-terre-haute-indiana-3-18-00d358/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 March 2000
* '''Site:''' Terre Haute, Indiana
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[Erik Winings]]
